mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting to an easing stance, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 150,000 jobs indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 100,000 jobs signals weakening labor market conditions, which raises uncertainty and compresses earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 102 suggests improving supply-side demand, which lowers production costs and supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 101 signals weakening supply-side demand, which raises production costs and compresses earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in CPIAUCSL inflation above 2.5% indicates the Federal Reserve is likely to hold rates steady, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in moderate inflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in strong labor markets are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
